summary: Per user directive, reframed Phase 3+4+5 as one combined effort and attempted to close the gate by building on handoff 04's landed CS5Combined canonical-model scaffold and its recommended 'cluster' semantic lead. Research-first: read Pacheco 2024's actual 'Canonical model for CKB' section (Lemmas 14-18, the exact chunks report 01 already cited) via literature-search.sh to re-verify the existing grounding before writing Lean -- confirms (does not overturn) that Lemma 18's negation-completeness step is unsound for a quasi-prime, disjunction-property-only H; no new transcribable technique found. Then worked through handoff 04's 'cluster' construction (designated L-world w0 plus a cluster of all prime extensions of HR, mutually S5-related) in full technical detail before writing Lean, and found it fails: cs5FC'' requires PLAIN symmetry and PLAIN transitivity (not just the weaker ≤-composed clauses), which force any hub-connected-to-two-or-more-worlds frame into full mutual connectivity. Landed this as a new, general, sorry-free, zero-axiom lemma cs5FC''_hub_forces_spoke_connectivity (CKExtension.lean, right after cs5FC_implies_cs5FC''). Working through the consequence shows the cluster idea reduces to the already-confirmed L-uniform dead end regardless of cluster size (full connectivity forces L-pure truth values uniform across the cluster, forcing box(psi) iff psi, which fails whenever A in H and box(A) not in H -- exactly the case in play). Separately documented (argued, not mechanized as a universal theorem) that any strategy using CSLib's generic Lindenbaum/prime-extension engine to build a witness world OMITTING a specific target formula is inherently circular for proving non-derivability, since that engine's precondition IS DerivExcludes of the target -- an input, never a byproduct. Combined with handoff 03's prior finding that a closure-stable derivation-induction invariant strong enough to conclude the exclusion is a semantic truth-predicate in disguise, all three currently-conceived routes (semantic model, generic-Lindenbaum witness, syntactic derivation-induction) now trace to the SAME fixed-point circularity: proving cs5Combined_seed_excludes in general requires machinery at least as strong as CS5Combined's own canonical completeness at the relevant heads, which handoff 04's mechanized cs5Combined_symmetric_tail_box_gap finding already shows is exactly as hard as CS5's own open box-backward problem. No sorry, no fabricated obstruction, no new axiom introduced. Full CI verified on the touched module and its downstream dependent (CS5Canonical); the repo-wide full lake build is currently blocked by an UNRELATED, pre-existing, concurrent in-progress edit to Cslib/Logics/Modal/Tableau/FrameCompleteness.lean (task 505's working tree, modified by a parallel session during this dispatch, not touched or caused by this dispatch -- confirmed via git log the file's last commit predates this session and the failure references an unrelated Relation.symm_rightEuclidean_iff_trans identifier in the Tableau subsystem, unconnected to Metalogic/Constructive).
